critical_code_review_comments: Fix #4 implementation is correct: SiteContext.jsx L113-162 derives tenant slug from window.location.hostname (PLATFORM_HOSTS whitelist + content-hub-pro-* preview → 'studio'), fetches /api/tenant/configuration/public/{slug} anonymously, reads configuration.default_locale, double-checks no explicit choice was made mid-flight, then sets locale state WITHOUT persisting — perfect tenant default behavior. Browser logs confirm endpoint returns 200 and locale switch fires.

Persistence semantics correctly preserved: setLocale (locale picker) writes localStorage.mfd_locale; the tenant-default useEffect early-returns when localStorage entry exists; setLocaleState bypass means tenant default never overwrites stored choice on subsequent visits. Verified on reload.

Fix B implementation correct: routers/journey_initiate.py now builds the unified runtime_identity envelope with utm, referer, lifestyle, account_id, atmosphere, journey_id, project_id, user_agent, tenant_slug, request_host, resolved_host, source_locale, onboarding_path, resolved_subdomain — full parity with routers/leads.py.

Console noise observation (not introduced by ITER146): /begin-journey emits several 401/404 errors from unrelated background fetches (analytics/heatmaps and possibly /api/tenant/configuration with credentials from another component). These do not affect functionality but obscure debugging. Worth filing a follow-up to audit anonymous fetch surface.

i18n leakage telemetry on /begin-journey footer surfaced one EN-US leak phrase 'della Manifattura' rendered while site is in en-US (LEAK count went 0→1 on reload to EN-US). Footer 'showroom' column appears to have an Italian phrase hardcoded in the EN-US bundle. Cosmetic, but worth fixing in next i18n sweep.
